newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy has non-EU trade surplus in November.
newsitem.headline: Italy has non-EU trade surplus in November.

text.p: Italy had a 4.706 trillion lire trade surplus with non-European Union countries in November, the national statistics office ISTAT said.
ITALY TRADE BALANCE (NON-EU) Nov 96 Oct 96 Nov 95
Cumulative yr to date +43.630 trln +38.924 trln +27.053 trln
Imports yr to date 115.214 trln 104.682 trln 121.140 trln
Exports yr to date 158.844 trln 143.606 trln 148.193 trln
Istat gave the following breakdown for the trade balance with European Union countries for October.
Note: Istat said Italy had a global trade surplus in October of 7.638 trillion lire with imports down 3.6 percent to 28.853 trillion lire and exports up 7.1 percent to 36.491 trillion.
In the first 10 months of 1996, Italy had a global trade surplus of 57.674 trillion lire, with imports down 4.3 percent to 263.78 trillion lire and exports up 2.5 percent to 321.454 trillion.
